textSlots.label: PAMA Homepage Mobile / move-in-style / story-copy / story-copy
textSlots.defaultValue: With almost one century of experience and a research and development department that continuously studies and works on new technologies, PAMA develops and manufactures boring machines, milling machines and machining centres for various sectors for which it guarantees quality and reliability.

textSlots.label: PAMA Homepage Mobile / products-section / products-copy / products-copy
textSlots.defaultValue: PAMA’s machine tools provide optimal precision and precisely perform boring, drilling, milling and turning operations, satisfying customer requirements in the most demanding industries.

textSlots.label: PAMA Homepage Mobile / solution-section / solution-copy / solution-copy
textSlots.defaultValue: PAMA is at the service of its customers and provides support to satisfy all their needs even for the most difficult machine tool applications.

textSlots.label: PAMA Homepage Mobile / support-section / support-body / support-body
textSlots.defaultValue: PAMA is proud of its many years of experience in the field of machine tools and provides its customers with a wide range of services and contracts to ensure the sustained highest level of performance of its products.

textSlots.label: PAMA Homepage Mobile / about-section / about-copy / about-copy
textSlots.defaultValue: PAMA is an Italian company that has been present in the machine tool market for over 90 years, known for building large and medium-large units, well appreciated in all sectors where maximum rigidity and high precision are required.
